items.markdown:
The best beach hotels in Phuket include Katathani Phuket Beach Resort, The Surin Phuket , and [Rosewood Phuket](https://www.rosewoodhotels.com/en/phuket) . These top-rated resorts offer direct access to soft white sand, stunning sea views, and five-star luxury amenities across the island's most desirable bays.[](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Hotels-g293920-zff10-Phuket-Hotels.html) [[1]](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Hotels-g293920-zff10-Phuket-Hotels.html)[[2]](https://northabroad.com/where-to-stay-phuket-best-hotels/)[[3]](https://www.cntraveller.com/gallery/phuket-hotels)

Top Luxury and Beachfront Resorts

- **Katathani Phuket Beach Resort:** Located directly on the quiet sands of Kata Noi Beach, featuring family-friendly pools and a serene beachfront setup.[](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Hotels-g293920-zff10-Phuket-Hotels.html) 
- **The Surin Phuket:** Nestled above the private, palm-fringed Pansea Beach with classic cottage-style design and a striking hexagonal pool.[](https://northabroad.com/where-to-stay-phuket-best-hotels/) 
- **Rosewood Phuket:** Situated on a secluded beachfront cliff and quiet bay near Patong, offering ultra-luxury private pool villas.[](https://northabroad.com/where-to-stay-phuket-best-hotels/) 
- **The Naka Island, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa:** A private island escape just off Phuket's east coast, reached via a brief speedboat ride.[](https://northabroad.com/where-to-stay-phuket-best-hotels/) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-yH4xS_MCj4&t=499)
- **[Phuket Marriott Resort & Spa, Merlin Beach](https://www.marriott.com/en-us/hotels/hktmb-phuket-marriott-resort-and-spa-merlin-beach/overview/):** Set on a peaceful stretch of Tri Trang Beach near Patong with direct reef access and expansive lagoon pools.[](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Hotels-g293920-zff10-Phuket-Hotels.html) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gcDqTCbZCFA&t=544)

If you share your **budget per night** and **who you are traveling with** (family, partner, or solo), I can recommend the best specific neighborhood and hotel for your trip.
